:::

::: {.absolute .pdf-text .body-text left="82.286" top="516.443" style="font-family:pdf9f2;font-size:26.606px;color:#1c1c1c;letter-spacing:-0.0405px;"}
```{=html}

```
:::

::: {.absolute .pdf-text .body-text left="82.286" top="561.107" style="font-family:pdf9f2;font-size:26.606px;color:#1c1c1c;letter-spacing:-0.0670px;"}

:::

::: {.absolute .pdf-text .body-text left="82.286" top="232.786" style="font-family:pdf9f2;font-size:26.606px;color:#1c1c1c;letter-spacing:-0.0522px;"}
```{=html}
<span>1) Resistance to Change: Long-term blockholders may resist necessary changes in </span>
```
:::

::: {.absolute .pdf-text .body-text left="82.286" top="268.763" style="font-family:pdf9f2;font-size:26.606px;color:#1c1c1c;letter-spacing:-0.0702px;"}
```{=html}
<span>management or strategy, particularly if those changes threaten their influence or personal </span>
```
:::

::: {.absolute .pdf-text .body-text left="82.286" top="304.741" style="font-family:pdf9f2;font-size:26.606px;color:#1c1c1c;letter-spacing:-0.0473px;"}

```{=html}
<span>benefits.</span>
```

:::

::: {.absolute .pdf-text .body-text left="82.286" top="354.386" style="font-family:pdf9f2;font-size:26.606px;color:#1c1c1c;letter-spacing:-0.0713px;"}

```{=html}
<span>2) Reduced Board Independence: Blockholders often have representatives on the board of </span>
```

```{=html}
<span>making.</span>
```

```{=html}
<span>"voice" (direct intervention) can prioritize strategies that increase stock liquidity or price </span>
```
